package consumer

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-kruda/kruda"
)

var generatedBinds int

type SearchOutput struct {
	ID   int
	Q    string
	Page int
}

func search(c *kruda.C[SearchInput]) (*SearchOutput, error) {
	return &SearchOutput{c.In.ID, c.In.Q, c.In.Page}, nil
}

func request(t *testing.T, client *kruda.TestClient, method, path string, status int) *kruda.TestResponse {
	t.Helper()
	resp, err := client.Request(method, path).Send()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if resp.StatusCode() != status {
		t.Fatalf("%s %s = %d, want %d: %s", method, path, resp.StatusCode(), status, resp.BodyString())
	}
	return resp
}

func TestAllGeneratedRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	app := kruda.New()
	var events []string
	app.OnRequest(func(c *kruda.Ctx) error { events = append(events, "request"); return nil })
	app.OnResponse(func(c *kruda.Ctx) error { events = append(events, "response"); return nil })
	app.OnParse(func(c *kruda.Ctx, input any) error {
		events = append(events, "parse")
		input.(*SearchInput).Q += "!"
		return nil
	})
	app.Use(func(c *kruda.Ctx) error { events = append(events, "global"); return c.Next() })
	outer := app.Group("/api").Use(func(c *kruda.Ctx) error { events = append(events, "outer"); return c.Next() })
	g := outer.Group("/v1").Use(func(c *kruda.Ctx) error { events = append(events, "inner"); return c.Next() })
	h := func(c *kruda.C[SearchInput]) (*SearchOutput, error) {
		events = append(events, "handler")
		return search(c)
	}
	methods := []struct {
		method string
		app    func(*kruda.App, string, func(*kruda.C[SearchInput]) (*SearchOutput, error), ...kruda.RouteOption)
		group  func(*kruda.Group, string, func(*kruda.C[SearchInput]) (*SearchOutput, error), ...kruda.RouteOption)
	}{
		{"GET", SearchInputGet[SearchOutput], SearchInputGroupGet[SearchOutput]},
		{"POST", SearchInputPost[SearchOutput], SearchInputGroupPost[SearchOutput]},
		{"PUT", SearchInputPut[SearchOutput], SearchInputGroupPut[SearchOutput]},
		{"DELETE", SearchInputDelete[SearchOutput], SearchInputGroupDelete[SearchOutput]},
		{"PATCH", SearchInputPatch[SearchOutput], SearchInputGroupPatch[SearchOutput]},
	}
	for _, m := range methods {
		path := "/" + strings.ToLower(m.method) + "/:id"
		m.app(app, path, h)
		m.group(g, path, h)
	}
	app.Compile()
	client := kruda.NewTestClient(app)
	for _, m := range methods {
		for _, prefix := range []string{"", "/api/v1"} {
			path := prefix + "/" + strings.ToLower(m.method) + "/42"
			for _, tc := range []struct {
				query string
				want  SearchOutput
			}{
				{"", SearchOutput{42, "all!", 1}},
				{"?id=99&q=go&page=3", SearchOutput{42, "go!", 3}},
			} {
				events = nil
				before := generatedBinds
				resp := request(t, client, m.method, path+tc.query, 200)
				var got SearchOutput
				if err := resp.JSON(&got); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if got != tc.want {
					t.Fatalf("output = %+v, want %+v", got, tc.want)
				}
				if generatedBinds != before+1 {
					t.Fatalf("automatic binder was not selected: %d -> %d", before, generatedBinds)
				}
				wantEvents := []string{"request", "global", "parse", "handler", "response"}
				if prefix != "" {
					wantEvents = []string{"request", "global", "outer", "inner", "parse", "handler", "response"}
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(events, wantEvents) {
					t.Fatalf("events = %v, want %v", events, wantEvents)
				}
			}
			bad := request(t, client, m.method, path+"?page=bad", 400)
			if !strings.Contains(bad.BodyString(), "page") {
				t.Fatalf("parse detail lost: %s", bad.BodyString())
			}
			invalid := request(t, client, m.method, path+"?page=0", 422)
			if !strings.Contains(invalid.BodyString(), `"field":"page"`) || !strings.Contains(invalid.BodyString(), `"rule":"min"`) {
				t.Fatalf("validation detail lost: %s", invalid.BodyString())
			}
			request(t, client, m.method, strings.TrimSuffix(path, "42")+"bad", 400)
		}
	}
}

func TestPlanPrecedenceAndOptionOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	app := kruda.New(kruda.WithOpenAPIInfo("routes", "1", ""))
	var logs bytes.Buffer
	previous := slog.Default()
	slog.SetDefault(slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logs, nil)))
	defer slog.SetDefault(previous)
	var overrideCalls int
	first := SearchInputPlan()
	first.Binder = func(*kruda.Ctx) (reflect.Value, error) {
		t.Fatal("earlier matching plan selected")
		return reflect.Value{}, nil
	}
	last := SearchInputPlan()
	last.Binder = func(*kruda.Ctx) (reflect.Value, error) {
		overrideCalls++
		return reflect.ValueOf(&SearchInput{ID: 91, Q: "override", Page: 9}).Elem(), nil
	}
	visible := []kruda.RouteOption{
		kruda.WithDescription("first"), kruda.WithTags("first"), kruda.WithGeneratedPlan(first),
		kruda.WithOpenAPISecurity("first", "read"), kruda.WithDescription("last"), kruda.WithTags("last"),
		kruda.WithGeneratedPlan(last), kruda.WithOpenAPISecurity("second", "write"),
	}
	backing := append(visible, kruda.WithDescription("sentinel-one"), kruda.WithDescription("sentinel-two"))
	before := append([]kruda.RouteOption(nil), backing...)
	opts := backing[:len(visible)]
	SearchInputGet(app, "/override", search, opts...)
	SearchInputGet(app, "/again", search, opts...)
	for i := range backing {
		if reflect.ValueOf(backing[i]) != reflect.ValueOf(before[i]) {
			t.Fatalf("caller backing array changed at %d", i)
		}
	}
	other := kruda.WithGeneratedPlan(kruda.GeneratedPlan[struct{}]{})
	SearchInputGet(app, "/crossed", search, other)
	SearchInputGet(app, "/empty", search, kruda.WithGeneratedPlan(kruda.GeneratedPlan[SearchInput]{}))
	stale := SearchInputPlan()
	stale.Shape.Fields = append([]kruda.BinderFieldShape(nil), stale.Shape.Fields...)
	stale.Shape.Fields[0].Default = "stale"
	stale.Binder = func(*kruda.Ctx) (reflect.Value, error) {
		t.Fatal("stale explicit plan selected")
		return reflect.Value{}, nil
	}
	SearchInputGroupGet(app.Group("/api"), "/stale", search, kruda.WithGeneratedPlan(stale))
	app.Compile()
	client := kruda.NewTestClient(app)
	for _, path := range []string{"/override", "/again", "/crossed", "/empty", "/api/stale"} {
		before := generatedBinds
		resp := request(t, client, "GET", path+"?q=generic&page=2", 200)
		var got SearchOutput
		if err := resp.JSON(&got); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		want := SearchOutput{7, "generic", 2}
		if path == "/override" || path == "/again" {
			want = SearchOutput{91, "override", 9}
		}
		if got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %+v, want %+v", path, got, want)
		}
		increment := 0
		if path == "/crossed" {
			increment = 1
		}
		if generatedBinds != before+increment {
			t.Fatalf("%s selected default binder unexpectedly: %d -> %d", path, before, generatedBinds)
		}
	}
	if overrideCalls != 2 || strings.Contains(logs.String(), "different input type") {
		t.Fatalf("override calls = %d, logs = %s", overrideCalls, logs.String())
	}
	resp := request(t, client, "GET", "/openapi.json", 200)
	var spec struct {
		Paths map[string]map[string]struct {
			Description string
			Tags        []string
			Security    []map[string][]string
		}
	}
	if err := resp.JSON(&spec); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{"/override", "/again"} {
		op := spec.Paths[path]["get"]
		if op.Description != "last" || !reflect.DeepEqual(op.Tags, []string{"last"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(op.Security, []map[string][]string{{"first": {"read"}}, {"second": {"write"}}}) {
			t.Fatalf("metadata order changed: %+v", op)
		}
	}
}

func TestStaleAndValidationFallback(t *testing.T) {
	app := kruda.New()
	StaleInputGet(app, "/stale", func(c *kruda.C[StaleInput]) (*StaleInput, error) { return &c.In, nil })
	UnsupportedInputPost(app, "/required", func(c *kruda.C[UnsupportedInput]) (*UnsupportedInput, error) { return &c.In, nil })
	ChangedValidationInputGet(app, "/changed", func(c *kruda.C[ChangedValidationInput]) (*ChangedValidationInput, error) { return &c.In, nil })
	client := kruda.NewTestClient(app)
	for _, tc := range []struct{ path, want string }{{"/stale", "fresh"}, {"/stale?q=ignored&fresh=current", "current"}} {
		resp := request(t, client, "GET", tc.path, 200)
		var got StaleInput
		if err := resp.JSON(&got); err != nil || got.Q != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("stale output = %+v, %v, want %s", got, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	request(t, client, "POST", "/required", 422)
	request(t, client, "POST", "/required?value=present", 200)
	request(t, client, "GET", "/changed?page=2", 422)
	request(t, client, "GET", "/changed?page=6", 200)
	custom := kruda.New()
	custom.Validator().Register("min", func(value any, param string) bool { return true })
	SearchInputGet(custom, "/custom", search)
	request(t, kruda.NewTestClient(custom), "GET", "/custom?page=0", 200)
	nilValidator := kruda.New(kruda.WithValidator(nil))
	SearchInputGet(nilValidator, "/nil", search)
	request(t, kruda.NewTestClient(nilValidator), "GET", "/nil?page=0", 200)
}

func ExampleSearchInputGet() {
	app := kruda.New()
	SearchInputGet(app, "/search", search)
	fmt.Println("registered")
	// Output: registered
}
